title: Company Operating Fleet — decision card
description: One line of decisions-pending.jsonl. Emitted by a fleet brain (references/company-operating-fleet.md §3); ranked by chief-of-staff. Authoritative over the illustrative block in the doctrine.

recommendation.description: Default action if the owner does not reply.

evidence_gate.description: WI-414 Default-FAIL gate verdict stamped by company-state.mjs append-decision: passed = >=1 evidence resolved; owner-ask = explicit <TBD> + ask:pick|approve; bypassed = --allow-ungrounded override (logged, not silent).

evidence_resolved.description: WI-414: the evidence[] entries that resolved to a real file/metric at append time.

scope.description: Routing tier (WI-408): app → the app's company-state; company → the company-decision repo's state.

actionability.description: PostHog-style triage tag set by chief-of-staff at synthesis: ready = owner can act now; needs-owner = blocked on one named owner input; needs-data = insufficient evidence (pair with a data-collection card).
